title: Things to do: learn how to make a manhattan and don’t miss High Spiri...
transcript: Gather around the candle as I attempt to make a Manhattan and tell you about high spirits at New York City Center. High spirits is a musical adapted from Noel Coward's play of Blithe Spirit, about a man haunted by the ghost of his dead wife. Originally produced on Broadway in 1964, it has not been revived since. So in true New York City center Encores! spirit, they are bringing it back for a two week staged concert run starting on February 4th. Not only is this production directed by one of my favourite directors, Jessica Stone, but it also stars this literally all star cast. I love anytime that Phillipa Soo and Steven Pasquale get to be on stage together. But also having Rachel Dratch and Katrina Lenk Andrea Martin. Like come on! Tickets are as cheap as $45. However, as with all New York City center productions, they do have the access program available. I am so excited! And cheers! Also, Manhattan with peach whiskey is really good, though it's very pale. I feel like the ratio of water to spirits was not correct. Whatever, it tastes good.
